mappings.assertion: TestLedgerRecordPaths accepts golden, driver, fixture and nested-package record paths and rejects an unknown golden kind, a golden directory, traversal, PROVENANCE, a path outside a package, a path outside internal/oracle, whitespace and a trailing slash, each naming line 2; TestPackageDir fixes package ownership for nested packages; TestRegenD56LaterPoints/each_point_is_regenerated_at_its_own_commit commits a driver-only C2 point carrying a driver-path record. TestRegenD56FiltersSelectDriverRecords: exact and recursive -pkg filters select driver records by their owning package, so a driver-only first C point is chained and an unchanged-driver record fails with record without change; recorded mutation (selected() splitting only at /testdata/golden/) turns the two exact-filter subtests red (the recursive ones pass either way).

TestRegenD56FlippedDriverAssertion: a C1 commit flips source.txt, the demo driver assertion and the golden; exit 0, the working call excludes the demo package, the other calls are pre/tagged and C1/untagged. Recorded mutation (exclusion removed, once by setting the engine's excluded set to nil, and permanently by the test's non-honouring regenerator): exit 2 with the driver assertion failure in the working baseline; TestRegenReproducesChangedSampleAssertion fails the same way under the nil-exclusion mutation. TestRegenD56PackageScope: a C record in an unselected package leaves selected packages on H1; a nested a3/control record excludes only a3/control; write-new writes nothing into a C package.

TestRegenD56FlippedDriverAssertion reports unchanged goldens of the C package as chain pre <pre>; TestRegenD56PreChangeState rejects a pre-C golden that is not reproduced (pre-change reproduction differs) and a golden first committed at the first C point (pre-change blob absent).

TestRegenD56LaterPoints runs C1, a driver-only C2 point and a determinism point, each regenerated at its own SHA and listed in the package line with its reason; a differing reproduction and a still-committed golden left unproduced fail with change point reproduction differs.

TestRegenD56TerminalDeletion: a recorded C deletion whose reproduction lacks the golden is ok ... deleted; still-produced golden (deletion not reproduced), deletion without record (change without record), deletion under a determinism record (missing) and working-tree-only deletion (missing) fail. Recorded mutations: accepting any record reason for a deletion, and reporting a still-produced deletion as an ordinary reproduction difference, each turn the matching subtest red.

TestRegenD56RejectsUnexplained: untracked golden in a C package (extra), unrecorded driver change after the first C point (change without record), merge changing a driver (merge changes oracle files), uncommitted driver edit (working tree differs from HEAD), driver-path record whose commit leaves the path unchanged (record without change); all exit 1 naming the path.

H1 with exit 0.
